channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mason Plumlee | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mason Plumlee from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Mason Plumlee, Steven Adams
item.description:
Beal on Plumlee and Adams being ejected after tussle:

“I think they both should've stayed in the game. They just got tussled up, caught up. Nobody threw any blows. Big dog tried to pick Mason up. Mason wasn't going for it. They just went to the floor. Two techs, let keep it moving.”

Bradley Beal on Mason Plumlee, Steven Adams, Mar 13, 2025. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Mason Plumlee, Jusuf Nurkic, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on playing Mason Plumlee and Oso Ighodaro over Jusuf Nurkic:

“They've been good for us, so we'll just continue to try and put together our best combinations”

Mike Budenholzer on Mason Plumlee, Jusuf Nurkic, Oso Ighodaro, Jan 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Mason Plumlee
item.description:
Law Murray:Kawhi on Plumlee injury:

“It hurts us. He's been very good, coming in that 2nd role, guarding their big. Tonight, unfortunately, he went down. Had to put in Moussa, doesn't have too much playing time. You kind of seen it with the rotations out there. In time, he'll get better.”

Kawhi Leonard on Mason Plumlee, Nov 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Mason Plumlee, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on what Kelly Olynyk brings:

“Spacing. No disrespect to Mason (Plumlee), they’re different players. Kelly spaces the floor, he’s a great passer.”

Dwane Casey on Mason Plumlee, Kelly Olynyk, Sep 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on facing Jerami Grant/Mason Plumlee:

“That team from last year... I'm going to remember those guys for the rest of my life. We made history. We did something nobody’s ever done before, coming back from 3-1 two times. We didn’t quit. I really appreciate all of them.”

Nikola Jokic on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Torrey Craig
item.description:
Katy Winge:Coach Malone on possibly becoming a more offensive-minded team with the loss of Plumlee, Grant, & Craig:

“I’m all about offense now baby! We’re going to score 130 a night.”

Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Torrey Craig, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on the @AltitudeSR pregame show ahead of Nuggets/Hornets:

“If we could all play as hard as Mason Plumlee we’d be a really good team.”

Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Mar 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Monte Morris on Mason Plumlee, Torrey Craig
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Monte Morris on Mason Plumlee and Torrey Craig attending Team USA Training Camp:

“I think it’s phenomenal….Them bringing that knowledge from USA Training Camp, if they can bring that to our training camp and teach me some more things about the game, that I’m looking forward to.”

Monte Morris on Mason Plumlee, Torrey Craig, Aug 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Mason Plumlee
item.description:
“I think Mason Plumlee is the most underrated player in the league,the way how he protects the paint, aggressiveness,”

Nikola Jokic on Mason Plumlee, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Kenneth Faried, Mason Plumlee
item.description:
“He’s been a starter in the NBA. Mason Plumlee’s been a starter on a playoff team, as well … if what’s best for our team is to bring Kenneth off the bench,right now, hey, go out there and play to the best to your ability.”

Michael Malone on Kenneth Faried, Mason Plumlee, Sep 26, 2017. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee
item.description:
TJ McBride:Malone on Plumlee:

“I've been impressed with his knowledge and how quickly he has picked up everything.”

Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @BSN_McBride.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
TJ McBride:Malone on Plumlee:

“We don't have many big available so Plumlee could get big minutes. He'll play with Nikola and without.”

Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Nikola Jokic, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @BSN_McBride.

item.title: Will Barton on Nikola Jokic, Mason Plumlee
item.description:
TJ McBride:Barton on Plumlee:

“He is a lot like Jokic in a sense being that he is a passing big man like that”

Will Barton on Nikola Jokic, Mason Plumlee, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @BSN_McBride.
